text:
anna.k: Heads up — Cerulean Health dedicated rollout proposed for Thu Mar 25 02:00 UTC. Need go/no-go and KMS check.

jamal.s: Thanks. Are we pinning to the hotfix build (v2.3.1-hotfix-a) or the main v2.4 candidate?

anna.k: Pin to v2.3.1-hotfix-a for this customer — they've regulatory windows and we want minimal surface.

deploybot: deploybot: rollout initiated: tenant=cerulean-health env=dedicated region=us-east-1 model=redwood-core:v2.3.1-hotfix-a slices=3 policy=staggered

mia-r: Quick checklist: KMS key rotation scheduled 03/25 01:30 UTC in acct-cerulean. If key rotates, tokens may fail until new key propagated. Can ops confirm override?

sre-oncall: Confirmed — KMS rotation can be postponed 30m. I'll coordinate with security. If withheld, we can proceed at 02:00.

kevin.t: Canary plan: 1) shift 10% traffic to slice-A for 10m, 2) 30% to slices A+B for 15m, 3) full. Rollback thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 300ms OR error surfaces in structured logs flagged by eval-suite.

anna.k: Add a safety gate: if token-cost per 1k tokens increases > 12% vs baseline, abort. Cerulean is cost-sensitive.

deploybot: deploybot: canary step 1 scheduled -> slice-A (10%) at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z; monitor window=10m; metrics=[5xx_rate,p95_latency,token_cost].

jamal.s: Release notes snippet for customer: "v2.3.1 hotfix — latency regressions addressed, stability fixes for KV cache, quantization parity maintained." I'll paste to support.

mia-r: Ops: please confirm LB drain script is set to 300s and no draining overlap with tenant slice swap. I saw an old script that drains 600s.

sre-oncall: Changed drain to 300s in infra repo and triggered a small redeploy. Link: https://git.internal/infracode/changes/2987 :thumbsup:

kevin.t: If canary is green after step 2, we wait 15m and then shift rest. If any gate trips, immediate rollback to v2.3.0-dedicated with traffic-shift back to previous IPs. Rollback procedure is in the runbook.

anna.k: Who will own the rollback click? @sre-oncall or @jamal.s?

jamal.s: I'll be primary for rollback ops for this window; @sre-oncall will be second.

deploybot: deploybot: canary step 1 complete -> 0.12% 5xx, p95=410ms, token_cost +3% -> continuing to step 2 (30%).

kevin.t: Observability note: enable eval-suite smoke prompts for Cerulean set; I pushed the prompt pack earlier. Double-check alerts for hallucination regressions.

mia-r: Also flag nearby certificate exp in dataplane for cert-id cdl-cert-2026-04-01. It won't affect this run but posting FYI.

deploybot: deploybot: canary step 2 complete -> 0.08% 5xx, p95=435ms, token_cost +6%. No alert triggers. Proceeding to full shift in 15m per policy.

anna.k: Go for full, team aligned. I'll send the customer notification after final green.

sre-oncall: I'll stay on the channel for +1h post-complete.

deploybot: deploybot: rollout complete -> tenant=cerulean-health version=v2.3.1-hotfix-a at 2026-03-25T02:41:30Z status=SUCCESS.

jamal.s: Customer notified. Support ticket #CH-4732 created with release notes and rollback SLA.

anna.k: Great job. Closing out — will file short post-deploy note in the runbook with observed p95 and cost deltas.

kevin.t: Post-deploy actions: schedule a perf regression run for the quantized variant in 48h and re-evaluate batching config.

mia-r: Thanks everyone — ops kept the KMS hold, no blips.

sre-oncall: :tada:
